transport_equipment_activity.value: Specialty truck-mounted vehicles and bodies: street sweepers, sewer cleaners, vacuum/hydroexcavator trucks, dump truck bodies, emergency vehicle signaling, road-marking equipment.

oem_supplier_role.value: Specialty vehicle and equipment manufacturer (OEM) selling to municipal and industrial customers through dealers and distributors; also supplies truck bodies and signaling products.

platform_program_concentration.value: Diversified across many brands and product lines; no single vehicle platform or program dominates.

aftermarket_original_equipment_mix.value: Mainly new equipment sales, plus parts, service centers and aftermarket support through dealer network.
